The boundary is `env.py`’s imported `Base.metadata`: Alembic compares only that `MetaData`; each independently declared `DeclarativeBase` owns a separate registry/metadata, so tables on other bases are invisible.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/command.py?L181-L213](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/command.py?L181-L213) - `command.revision()` enables the environment and invokes `RevisionContext.run_autogenerate()` for `--autogenerate`.
- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/templates/generic/env.py?L17-L21](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/templates/generic/env.py?L17-L21) - The application imports its models here and assigns `target_metadata = Base.metadata`.
- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/templates/generic/env.py?L53-L72](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/templates/generic/env.py?L53-L72) - `run_migrations_online()` passes that object to `context.configure(target_metadata=target_metadata)`.
- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/runtime/environment.py?L416-L447](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/runtime/environment.py?L416-L447) - `EnvironmentContext.configure()` accepts and propagates the target `MetaData`.
- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/autogenerate/api.py?L47-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/autogenerate/api.py?L47-L57) - `compare_metadata()` compares the database schema against the supplied `MetaData`.
- [sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1:alembic/autogenerate/compare.py?L103-L130](/r/github.com/sg-evals/alembic--rel_1_13_1/-/blob/alembic/autogenerate/compare.py?L103-L130) - `_autogen_for_tables()` obtains database table names and compares them with the target metadata’s tables.
- [sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29:lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_api.py?L522-L561](/r/github.com/sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29/-/blob/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_api.py?L522-L561) - `_setup_declarative_base()` creates a registry, uses supplied `metadata` or creates one, then assigns `Base.metadata = Base.registry.metadata`.
- [sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29:lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_api.py?L627-L681](/r/github.com/sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29/-/blob/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_api.py?L627-L681) - `DeclarativeBase` documentation explains per-base registry/metadata configuration and default creation.
- [sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29:lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py?L1690-L1733](/r/github.com/sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29/-/blob/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py?L1690-L1733) - Declarative mapping constructs each model’s `Table` using `_metadata_for_cls(manager)`.
- [sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29:lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py?L1747-L1752](/r/github.com/sg-evals/sqlalchemy--rel_2_0_29/-/blob/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py?L1747-L1752) - `_metadata_for_cls()` selects the class/base metadata, otherwise the registry metadata.
